source: old Wong validation, selected by key hash; no Harvard predictions
weighted_ap_check: passed including score ties and zero sample weights

config.secondary: Top-K hits, precision, enrichment; trapezoidal PR-AUC descriptive
config.ensemble: equal mean of the three fixed members
config.tie_policy: descending score then ascending compound_key; also report cutoff-tie-averaged precision

bootstrap.comparison: paired AP differences relative to scratch_descriptors_3

config.target: AID1259311 deposited binary growth-screen labels, NOT Wong labels or MIC
config.claim_boundary: Cross-assay retrospective ranking; concentration unknown; not actinomycete-specific or discovery validation
config.subsets: Only the scaffold-unseen inventory; wider identity inventory is not evaluated
config.failure_policy: Stop on invalid features or inference; do not silently drop compounds
config.post_evaluation: Becomes historical evaluation; cannot be reused as untouched test for adaptive changes
